SELECT s.agent_id AS agentId, d.name AS agentName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS userCount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS requestCount, MAX(m.create_time) AS lastRequestTime FROM tbl_data_chat_session s INNER JOIN tbl_platform_account_info a ON a.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN tbl_data_chat_message m ON s.id = m.session_id LEFT JOIN tbl_data_agent d ON d.id = s.agent_id
s.status != 'deleted'
AND s.agent_id = #{query.agentId}
AND (d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND m.create_time >= #{query.startTime}::timestamp
AND m.create_time <= #{query.endTime}::timestamp
GROUP BY s.agent_id, d.name ORDER BY requestCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, a.username AS username, a.real_name AS realName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.agent_id) AS agentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS requestCount, MAX(m.create_time) AS lastRequestTime FROM tbl_data_chat_session s INNER JOIN tbl_platform_account_info a ON a.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN tbl_data_chat_message m ON s.id = m.session_id
s.status != 'deleted'
AND (a.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR a.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND m.create_time >= #{query.startTime}::timestamp
AND m.create_time <= #{query.endTime}::timestamp
GROUP BY s.user_id, a.username, a.real_name ORDER BY requestCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
